ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Mr. Ramos gave a test to his class of $20$ students. The dot plot below shows the distribution of test scores.
<image1>
Later Mr. Ramos discovered that there was a scoring error on one of the questions. He regraded the tests, awarding some of the students $5$ extra points, which increased the median test score to $85$. What is the minimum number of students who received extra points?

(Note that the median test score equals the average of the $2$ scores in the middle if the $20$ test scores are arranged in increasing order.)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The attached dot plot has score labels 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100. Counting the dots gives: 65 has 2 students, 70 has 2, 75 has 4, 80 has 5, 85 has 2, 90 has 3, 95 has 1, and 100 has 1, for 20 students total. Reasoning: Since there are 20 scores, the median is the average of the 10th and 11th ordered scores. Initially, the number of scores below 85 is 2 + 2 + 4 + 5 = 13. For the 11th score to be 90, there would need to be at most 10 scores below 90. But even if the two original 85s are raised to 90, all original scores 65, 70, 75, and 80 remain below 90 after at most a 5-point increase; that is 2 + 2 + 4 + 5 = 13 scores below 90. So the 11th score cannot be 90 or higher. Therefore, for the median to be 85, the 10th and 11th final scores must both be 85. To make the 10th score 85, there can be at most 9 scores below 85. There are initially 13 scores below 85. The only scores below 85 that can become 85 with one 5-point award are the original 80s. So the count below 85 must drop from 13 to 9, requiring 4 of the 80-score students to receive extra points. Check: If 4 of the five 80s are raised to 85, then there are 9 scores below 85 and enough scores equal to 85, so the 10th and 11th scores are both 85. Thus the minimum number of students is 4.

method.method_draft: Use an ordered-list and best-case trial argument. From the image, write the original ordered positions: ranks 1–2 are 65, 3–4 are 70, 5–8 are 75, 9–13 are 80, 14–15 are 85, 16–18 are 90, 19 is 95, and 20 is 100. From the text, each regraded test can increase by only 5 points, and the final median uses ranks 10 and 11. To maximize the median with a small number of awards, the useful students to award first are those scoring 80, because each such award changes an 80 into an 85 and directly moves the middle block upward; awarding below 80 cannot reach 85, and awarding above 80 does not remove the 80s from the middle ranks. With only 3 awards, at best three 80s become 85s, leaving two 80s at ranks 9 and 10 and making rank 11 equal 85, so the median is only 82.5. With 4 awards, four 80s become 85s, leaving one 80 at rank 9 and putting 85s in ranks 10 and 11, so the median is 85. Thus the minimum is 4.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中的点图在分数 65、70、75、80、85、90、95、100 上方分别有点。数点可得：65 有 2 人，70 有 2 人，75 有 4 人，80 有 5 人，85 有 2 人，90 有 3 人，95 有 1 人，100 有 1 人，总共 20 人。因此原始有序成绩位置为：第 1–2 名是 65，第 3–4 名是 70，第 5–8 名是 75，第 9–13 名是 80，第 14–15 名是 85，第 16–18 名是 90，第 19 名是 95，第 20 名是 100。

推理：20 个成绩的中位数是第 10 个和第 11 个成绩的平均数。每个被加分的学生只增加 5 分。为了用尽量少的加分人数把中位数提高到 85，最有用的是给原来得 80 分的学生加分，因为 80 加 5 变成 85，能直接把中间位置的 80 往上推；低于 80 的成绩加 5 后达不到 85，而高于 80 的成绩加分不能移除中间位置的 80。若只有 3 人加分，最好也只是把 3 个 80 变成 85，此时还剩 2 个 80，排序后第 10 个是 80，第 11 个是 85，中位数为 (80+85)/2=82.5，不够 85。若有 4 人加分，把 4 个 80 变成 85，则只剩 1 个 80，排序后第 10 个和第 11 个都是 85，中位数正好是 85。因此最少需要 4 名学生得到额外 5 分。
